title: Smart Start Account and GAA Savings Goal
bankEvent: Parents deposit weekly pocket money into Paul's Smart Start Account
description: Paul is 11, loves sport, and mostly spends on GAA gear. BOI Buddy turns pocket money deposits into an achievable savings habit tied to his birthday goal.

microJourney.signal: €20 parent transfer posted to Smart Start Account
microJourney.insight: Hey Paul! €20 has gone into your account. If you put €5 into your Smart Start Money Pot each week, you could have €100 by your birthday for GAA gear.
microJourney.customerReaction: Paul opens the app and checks his sports spend summary.
microJourney.bankOutcome: Insight open rate increases and savings intent is created.

microJourney.insight: BOI Buddy chat: Want me to auto-move €5 every week to your Smart Start Money Pot and track your birthday progress?
microJourney.bankOutcome: Recurring savings goal activated and tracked in-app.

messages.text: Can you help me save for GAA gear before my birthday?
Yes. I can set a Smart Start goal of €100 by your birthday. If we move €5 each week from your pocket money, your timeline is on track.
Will I still have money left for small treats?
Based on your recent spending, yes. The €5 weekly transfer keeps your balance healthy while building your goal steadily.
Okay, set the weekly transfer and track progress.
Done. Your Money Pot is active at €5 per week. I will send progress updates and milestone points you can redeem for vouchers.

microJourney.insight: Great start, Paul. You are 5% of the way to your €100 target. Keep this up and you will hit your birthday goal.
microJourney.customerReaction: Paul keeps the transfer active and checks progress.
microJourney.bankOutcome: Goal adherence improves through timely nudges.

microJourney.insight: Email to parent: Paul is on track for his GAA goal. If he maintains this pace, he can unlock points redeemable for vouchers.
microJourney.customerReaction: Parent encourages Paul to continue weekly saving.
microJourney.bankOutcome: Family engagement strengthens long-term account retention.

microJourney.insight: Banker prompt: Offer a quick parent check-in on youth saving habits and reward milestones.
microJourney.bankOutcome: Higher confidence in BOI advice and deeper relationship value.

title: Transition to Student Account

description: Paul is now 17 and transitioning to a Student Account. BOI Buddy analyzes his savings behavior and introduces a simple budget for driving lessons or college fees.

microJourney.insight: You are ready for a Student Account, Paul. It is designed for your next stage and works with your current savings habits.
microJourney.customerReaction: Paul reviews benefits and taps to continue.
microJourney.bankOutcome: Seamless product migration with no attrition.

microJourney.insight: BOI Buddy chat: Based on your saving pattern, start a light monthly budget and split it into Driving Lessons and College Fees goals.

microJourney.bankOutcome: Goal adoption increases financial planning behavior.

messages.text: I am moving to a Student Account. How should I budget for driving lessons and college fees?
Good timing. From your savings pattern, a light monthly budget works. I recommend splitting your goal into Driving Lessons and College Fees so both keep moving.
What monthly amount should I start with?
Start with a low commitment that you can keep every month. Your current history supports this level without stressing your weekly spending.
Set it up and remind me if I fall behind.
Configured. Both goals are live, and I will alert you early if spending drifts so you can stay on track.

microJourney.signal: First week spending remains inside target
microJourney.insight: Nice work. You are on budget this week and still contributing to both goals.
microJourney.customerReaction: Paul keeps weekly spending limits active.
microJourney.bankOutcome: Improved budget consistency and app stickiness.

microJourney.signal: Seven-day budget and goal data available
microJourney.insight: Email: Your weekly budget snapshot is ready. You are pacing well for driving lessons and college fee targets.
microJourney.customerReaction: Paul and parent review progress together.
microJourney.bankOutcome: Higher transparency and confidence in BOI guidance.

microJourney.insight: Banker task: Offer a short check-in to optimize goal allocation between near-term driving costs and college timeline.
microJourney.bankOutcome: Retention and primacy strengthened before adulthood account competition.

title: Early Career Salary-Rent Cycle
bankEvent: Monthly salary arrives and rent exits, triggering mortgage saver recommendation
description: Paul starts his early career. BOI Buddy recognizes stable salary and rent patterns and suggests a Mortgage Saver account to convert habit into future home readiness.

microJourney.signal: Salary in and rent out pattern stabilizes over 3 months
microJourney.insight: You now have a reliable monthly surplus after rent. You are in a strong position to start a Mortgage Saver account.
microJourney.bankOutcome: Mortgage saver intent captured in-app.

microJourney.insight: BOI Buddy chat: Set a Home Deposit goal now. I can recommend an amount that still keeps your rent-month buffer safe.
microJourney.customerReaction: Paul accepts a monthly deposit target.
microJourney.bankOutcome: Home deposit goal launched with realistic contribution schedule.

messages.text: My salary comes in and rent goes out right away. Can I still save for a home?
Yes. Your salary-rent pattern shows a repeatable surplus. You are ready for a Mortgage Saver plan without compromising essential bills.
How much can I move safely each month?
I calculated a contribution level that protects your rent-month buffer. It is enough to build a deposit consistently and still keep flexibility.
Activate it the day after salary.
Done. Your salary-linked transfer is active and your Home Deposit goal is now tracking monthly progress.

microJourney.insight: We can auto-move your savings the day after salary to reduce friction and protect consistency.
microJourney.bankOutcome: Consistent monthly savings inflow established.

microJourney.insight: Email: Great start. At your current pace, your projected home deposit in 24 months is clearly on track.
microJourney.bankOutcome: Confidence in plan increases persistence.

microJourney.insight: Banker prompt: Offer a pre-mortgage readiness review and explain documentation timeline early.
microJourney.bankOutcome: Higher probability of BOI mortgage origination.

title: Mature Saving Habits and ISA Recommendation
bankEvent: Consistent savings history triggers ISA suitability recommendation
description: By age 30-34, Paul has built consistent savings habits. BOI Buddy recommends an ISA as the next step for tax-efficient long-term growth and life-goal resilience.

microJourney.signal: Savings consistency and balance growth cross recommendation threshold
microJourney.insight: You have built excellent savings discipline. An ISA could help your money work harder while supporting long-term goals.
microJourney.bankOutcome: High-intent wealth journey begins.

microJourney.insight: BOI Buddy chat: Let us map your goals (family security, dream home upgrades, education support) to an ISA contribution plan.
microJourney.customerReaction: Paul sets goal-linked ISA contribution levels.
microJourney.bankOutcome: Personetics goals tools directly tied to wealth product adoption.

messages.text: I have better saving habits now. Should I open an ISA?
Yes. Your consistency and balances indicate ISA suitability. It is a strong next step for tax-efficient long-term growth.
Can we connect it to my life goals, not just one generic target?
Absolutely. We can map your goals tools plan across family security, home upgrades, and education support, then assign contribution levels per goal.
Apply that plan and keep it simple for me.
Done. Your ISA contributions are now goal-linked, and I will provide monthly insight updates with adjustments when your cashflow changes.

microJourney.insight: Quick reminder: your monthly ISA contribution is due tomorrow. Keeping consistency protects your long-term plan.
microJourney.bankOutcome: Sustained contribution behavior maintained.

microJourney.insight: Email: Your ISA is active. Here is your contribution summary and long-term projection by each life goal.
microJourney.bankOutcome: Household confidence supports retention and wallet share.

microJourney.insight: Banker task: Offer annual ISA optimization review and align contributions with upcoming family milestones.
microJourney.bankOutcome: Long-term wealth relationship deepened.
